description: Calculate the band gap of Mn-doped CeO2 (111) surface. Mn substitution at Ce site introduces Mn 3d mid-gap states and narrows the effective gap. PBE severely underestimates the gap.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of Mn-doped CeO2 (111) surface (cubic, Fm-3m), where one Ce atom at surface is substituted by Mn, and report its value in eV.
